method: Manual native Chrome interactions with accessibility-state verification and screenshot inspection; not an automated cross-browser suite.

Admin table/counts and self-protection controls rendered correctly.
Catalog edit/save displayed the updated synthetic description.
Fresh catalog update appeared in audit with actor/target/time and field names, excluding values.

Pricing matched plan rows and disclosed missing billing.
Keyboard search returned explanations, declared fallback and catalog plus live Kaggle cards.
Pointer-submitted search completed with catalog and Kaggle results.
Sign-out returned to login and removed admin links.

limits: Password-change/reset-delivery/deletion UI submissions and full mobile/cross-browser coverage were not exercised. API security behavior is tested separately.
